verdict.rationale: Xero's app marketplace lists a third-party partner (Q2X) that explicitly handles QuickBooks-to-Xero migrations 'ensuring a smooth transition of your historical data,' and Xero even subsidizes 'simple conversions,' showing migration support exists. However this is a third-party service rather than a native first-party import tool, is scoped mainly to QuickBooks, and no evidence details preservation of full transaction-level granularity or migration from other accounting systems generally. Missing for 10: native first-party migration/import tooling, evidence covering non-QuickBooks source systems, and detail on transaction-level fidelity guarantees.
